title: Thai Beef Relleno Bites
description: A fusion Thai dish using beef relleno, with spicy rocoto sauce and crunchy yellow pepper.
instructions: 1. Heat 1/2 cup vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the diced beef relleno and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the diced rocoto pepper and yellow pepper, cook for another 2-3 minutes.
4. In a small bowl, mix the Peruvian yellow pepper sauce with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
5. Add the sauce to the beef mixture and stir to combine.
6. Using a small cookie scoop, form the beef mixture into small balls and flatten slightly.
7. Fry the beef relleno bites in the hot oil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
8. Remove the bites from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
